decision.justification: Series is trend-dominated with strong upward trend and moderate seasonality, non-stationary and highly predictable. ONLY_CWT_rf is the trend and seasonality champion and is best in two of three validation windows with a separated validation margin over all combinations, indicating the single model captures the dominant structure without adding correlated-error noise.
